feature: A scripted walk can place a measurement
summary: A walk that drives the app can now make a measurement and prove it, on a blank canvas and on an opened screenshot, and when a walk stops half way through placing one the log says what the caliper is still waiting for instead of showing an empty list.
setup: Nothing to turn on. Run Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/measure-lands-in-the-list-walk.json and read /tmp/photonz-playtest/measure-lands-in-the-list/log.json.

try.do: Open the log and find stage 1-two-clicks-is-not-enough: measuring reads "both feet are down, waiting for a click to park the number"
Find stage 2-blank-canvas-measured: measures names Width = 200 px and the dock has grown a Measurements section
Find stage 3-screenshot-measured: measures names Width = 120 px on the Save Changes button of the opened screenshot
In the app, pick the ruler and click three times: one end, the other end, then once more to park the number
Watch the number land and a row appear under Measurements in the right hand panel

evaluate: Reading the log, is it obvious why two clicks left nothing, without going to the code?
Is three clicks the right number for a distance measurement, or should letting go of a drag be enough?
When a measurement lands, does the Measurements row tell you enough to recognise which one it is?
Does the number park somewhere your eye already is, or somewhere you have to hunt for?
rough: The bug as reported did not exist. A scripted walk could always place a measurement; it takes THREE clicks, not two, and the walk that reported the problem used two. What was genuinely missing was any word about why, so the fix is a line in the log rather than a change to the tool.

Two footguns bite walk authors here. Pressing I when the ruler is already up cycles the MODE rather than arming the tool, so a walk that re-arms with a key press quietly ends up in a different mode; use the measureMode step. And an open step that ran after another document silently kept driving the OLD window while the log printed the new file's name, which is fixed.

Size mode finds nothing over a shape you drew yourself: hover the middle of a rectangle on a blank canvas and the hint still reads "Click an element for its width and height" with no highlight. It works over a pasted screenshot. Filed separately.
Scripts/playtest/distance-lands-on-release.json claims a drag lands a caliper. It does not with the flag as it ships, and the walk goes on to say it did. Filed separately.
